biggest_catch: Only the referrer-side $30 amount is stated on the official page; prepaid plan, and the friend must call in and make their initial payment before your credit posts.
catches: Only the referrer-side reward ($30 per referral) is explicitly stated on the official referral page; the referred friend's own benefit is not confirmed there.
Acacia sells prepaid electricity; the friend must call in to sign up, provide your account number (or name and service address), and make their initial payment before your $30 credit is issued.
The $10 second-tier bonus only applies if your referral themselves refers someone who signs up.
Credits apply to the kWh-usage portion of the bill only, not taxes/fees; credits are non-transferable and unused credits end when the account closes.
The amount Acacia offers may be changed at any time (per the official terms), so $30 is the current advertised amount.
Prepaid plans typically carry higher effective rates and immediate-disconnect risk on non-payment vs postpaid plans.
Framing: a prepaid-balance credit reduces future electricity cost; you must already be an Acacia customer to earn referrer-side credits.
